Chart stored projected costs for the current project

## Synopsis

```text
Read stored cost history without running a plan. Terraform directories resolve the current project identity without --stack; --include-workspace opts into workspace scoping. Pulumi histories use --stack.
```

```text
finfocus cost history view [flags]
```

## Examples

```bash
  finfocus cost history view --stack dev --plain
  finfocus cost history view --stack dev --split-providers
  finfocus cost history view --stack dev --output json
```

## Options

```text
      --currency string                Show snapshots in this currency (for example USD)
      --from string                    Chart start date (YYYY-MM-DD)
      --height int                     Chart height in rows (default 15)
  -h, --help[=true|false]              help for view
      --no-annotations[=true|false]    Hide deployment annotations
      --no-budget[=true|false]         Hide the budget threshold line
      --output string                  Output format: plain, json (default "plain")
      --plain[=true|false]             Force plain chart output
      --provider string                Chart one provider (aws, gcp, azure)
      --split-providers[=true|false]   Show one series per provider
      --strict[=true|false]            Fail when the range contains more than one currency
      --to string                      Chart end date (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive)
      --width int                      Chart width in columns (0 = terminal width)
```
